variant.author: 0x0ade
variant.changelog:
**New Plugin**: Glamour Roulette is a plugin for Final Fantasy XIV that randomly selects one of your saved Glamour Plates and swaps to it.
- Allows the user to select eligible gearsets to be randomized.
- Don't know what to wear tonight? Glamour Roulette has you covered!
variant.description: Did you know that the EQ presets in the system settings are powered by a 4-band EQ? Let's make our own presets!
variant.name: CustomEqualizer
variant.punchline: Tweak the built-in 4-band EQ with custom presets.
